tasks.short: Compile rental listings once, check consent, and publish the checked ones.

steps.what: Compile available rental properties into listing drafts.

loop.check: A field with no source stays empty
loop.why_not_simpler: Owners describe a flat in a sentence, not in fields

steps.what: Check completeness and consent before a listing is public.
Solicit missing rental listings by phone where consent exists.
Publish only the listings marked complete and allowed.
Drop the second typing of rental listings already stored.

tasks.design: Owner notes are compiled once into a draft. The agent checks completeness and consent. Missing listings are solicited by phone only where consent exists, and the call is not recorded. Only a checked listing is published. A second typing into a side sheet is eliminated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rental availability lived in mail and a side sheet, and was typed again into the listing.
tasks.enabler_now: Rent, place and dates can be fields. An owner's consent to publish cannot be assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing a listing that is incomplete in a way a required-field check will not see.
tasks.human_edge: The agent leaves a listing unpublished.

ambition.what: Each rental is marked publish, chase or drop before it can appear in public.

tasks.altitude: Owner calls for missing facts stay. The agent can refuse to publish, and no longer keeps a second list.

reach.task: Set what a rental listing must contain before it is public
reach.learn: Which gaps the broker treats as blocking

evidence.claim: Calls to ask an owner for a listing need a prior consent record, including where the owner is already known.
This design does not record those calls. Recording that can monitor staff needs works-council consent.
Compiling fields once removes a second typing. The decision to publish stays with the agent.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from owner notes to a published rental listing or an open chase. A side spreadsheet of the same listings is the step that goes.
Fields: place, rent, size, available from, and consent to publish. The owner produces the missing facts. Fallback: leave the field empty and do not publish.
Use the listing record in {CRM} before a new store. Upkeep of 4 hours covers required fields.
The class says amplify. Publishing still needs the agent's mark. Photos are not restyled in this task.
unknowns: Whether owners already send structured details.
Which listing service the office must update.
research_questions: What share of drafts are held back for a missing fact or missing consent?

incremental.description: Review required listing fields when the office changes what it will publish

approvals.approved_version: rental listing version the agent checked

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: notes are messy and most listings need a phone call, so the compile saves little. High: complete notes publish after one check, the second typing is gone, and thin listings are still phoned.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Owner calls for missing rental facts stay. Listings are compiled once and published only as the version the agent marked, with consent.
reach: Real estate brokers: set the fields a rental listing must have before it is public
skills_to_grow: Holding a listing back when consent or a fact is missing
Refusing a second list of the same rentals
role.ambitious_version: An available rental is either a checked listing or an open chase, and it is typed once.
